steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each interval change is matched to its failure data. A lengthened interval on a critical asset is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Lengthened interval on a critical asset
findings.fix: Keep the interval until the data supports the change

findings.title: Interval change with no failure data

outcome.notChecked: Whether the failure data is complete.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] interval-critical.md:12  Lengthened interval on a critical asset.
       Fix: Keep the interval until the data supports the change.
[medium] interval-motor.md:19  Interval change with no failure data.
       Fix: Attach the failure data.
[low] interval-bearing.md:26  Failure data incomplete.
       Fix: Complete the record.
Not checked: Whether the failure data is complete.
pros: Checks an interval change with no failure data, and a lengthened interval on a critical asset.
cons: Not checked: Whether the failure data is complete.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ind-preventive-plan-revision skill on the records for this review.
